newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN V LIVERPOOL TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN V LIVERPOOL TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Thursday's European Cup Winners' Cup semifinal first leg between Paris St Germain and Liverpool:
Paris St Germain - 1-Bernard Lama; 13-Laurent Fournier, 4-N'Gotty, 6-Paul Leguen, 19-Jerome Leroy; 15-Benoit Cauet, 8-Vincent Guerin, 7-Leonardo, 22-Didier Domi, 10-Rai (captain), 11-Patrice Loko.

Liverpool - 1-Davis James; 21-Dominic Matteo, 4-Jason McAteer, 5-Mark Wright, 20-Stig Bjornebye; 12-Steve Harkness, 7-Steve McManaman, 8-Stan Collymore, 10-John Barnes (captain), 9-Robbie Fowler, 11-Jamie Redknapp.
